title: Whoa! Someone seriously tough just showed up~

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The condition has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us race, Miss Pandora!
Engage in a splendid slugfest with this royal princess!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This horsegirl is Kawakami Princess. A boisterous, rough-and-tumble girl who adores the anime "Roaring Princess ☆ Princess Fighter".

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kawakami-senpai! 'Sup! ☆
You and me, racing?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! That person over there asked me to!
They said they wanted me to beat you black and blue to toughen you up!
choice_data_list: I never said that! I didn't say anything about beating her up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...What I actually asked for was, "Please stand before Fusaichi Pandora as a formidable rival."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess was debuting in the same generation as Fusaichi Pandora. If Pandora couldn't even put up a good fight against her, her future would be bleak.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey, let's take it easy-peasy then.
Take care of me, Kawakami-senpai! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let us run a race filled with dreams together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: FILLED WITH DREEEEEAMS!!! DOSSEEEEEEEEEI!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ha, what is this?!
Splendid? More like a raging stampede...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess's competitive spirit was off the charts.
She pulled away from the half-heartedly running Fusaichi Pandora in no time...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess of justice shall never lose! ♪
PRINCESS... DESTRUUUUCTIOOOOOON!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! So mean! Hey, hold on, what the heck—?!
Are you for reaaaal...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Match over. Or rather, a clash between "a bundle of pure grit" and "a marshmallow heart" wasn't much of a match to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You put up quite a fight yourself, Miss Pandora!
Yet it is precisely when driven to the edge of the cliff that a princess shines the brightest!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, I was definitely not driven to any cliff.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let us do this again sometime!
I shall neither run nor hide!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uuugh~~~, I thought I'd manage somehow, but I was totally pathetic~~~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surely, this defeat would sting—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, whatever! I tried my best in my own way! ☆
Today was just luck! Guess luck wasn't on my side, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It didn't sting in the slightest... But I needed her to turn over a new leaf and climb back up, or this would never work.
choice_data_list: My condition is that you beat Kawakami Princess.
My condition is that you beat Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~~, that bar is set way too high~.
I wonder if I can do it... And if I can't...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'd hate it if you weren't my Trainer anymore...
There aren't many people I could have this much fun with~.
choice_data_list: Then you'll just have to find a way to win!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about this!
What if you make me win, Trainer? ☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, that totally works!
It's settled! Please take care of me and teach me how to run! ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was an unexpected proposal... but it was far better than having her give up without trying. I decided to look after her until the next match.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
One, two~. One...
Hmm~~~, this might be... my absolute limit...
choice_data_list: Wait, it looks like you still have plenty of stamina left...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh... really?
Well, as far as I'm concerned, it's pretty much a no-can-do...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*Huff*, *puff*...
Ahhh, I'm so tired, but I gotta run all ten laps properly!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, did my pace drop? 
Well, since I'm running so much, this is totally fine, right? ☆
choice_data_list: (This girl...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It might not be her fault entirely... She was trying to do her best. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her bar for "giving it her all!" was set extraordinarily low.
At this rate, no matter how much training she did, the results would be negligible.
choice_data_list: I need to... do something about this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I couldn't just leave it to her own initiative. Simply making her follow a routine wouldn't yield any real growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This was the moment to prove my mettle as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, what're we doing today?
choice_data_list: I've placed a present... at the top of the slope!
I've placed a present... at the top of the slope!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat, seriously?! For me?!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Go sprint up and grab it with everything you've got!
Yup! Go sprint up and grab it with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Okay! Hell yeah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, yay! You're giving this to me, Trainer?
Thank youuu! ☆
choice_data_list: Yeah, your speed sprinting up there was incredible!
Yup, your speed sprinting up there was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, I just wanted to get it right away! Pretty amazing, huh~?
Come on, praise me, praise me, give me more praise! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...?
W-Who's that horsegirl wearing a mask?
choice_data_list: That's your running partner, the Masked Mapo Fiend!
I'm your pacing partner, the Fiery Mapo Tofu Mask!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what?! Wait, you're gonna chase after me
wearing that bright red mapo mask?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ew, gross... It looks scorching hot just staring at it!
Stay away from meee!
choice_data_list: Keep that pace up! Just make sure not to trip!
Keep that pace up! Just make sure not to trip!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yuuuum! Trainer, this super-nutritious meal
might just be my fave thing you've ever made for me♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Plus, there's no gross veggies in it~
Yay, so yummy, totally delish☆
choice_data_list: Right? Pretty tasty, wouldn't you say?
Right? Pretty tasty, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Hey Trainer, aren't you getting, like,
seriously amazing at cooking?! I'm gonna scarf it all down and get super strong!
choice_data_list: (Alright, she didn't notice!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Carefully seasoning it to Fusaichi Pandora's exact tastes and finely mincing all the veggies into the dish was worth the effort. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No way! Trainer, look at this time...!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you did it!
Yeah, you did it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So amazing, so cool☆ I'm already a genius, but you're making me an even bigger genius!! You're the best, Trainer♪ Total god tier, an absolute superhuman!
choice_data_list: No, no, you're the real genius here...!
No, no, you're the real genius here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I almost blurted out, before catching myself.
I shouldn't spoil her too much. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This overwhelming urge to shower her with unconditional praise...
choice_data_list: Uh-oh... I'm turning into a doting parent...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, she was quite a handful. But the more effort she required, the stronger the bond grew. That was undeniably true as well...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I can totally win against Kawakami-senpai this time, right?
All right, don't underestimate a genius♪ Next time for sure...! NEXT TIME FOR SUREEE!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get hyped up!
I'm gonna show everyone what I'm made of!
choice_data_list: Yeah, but don't overdo—no, go give it your all!
Yeah, but don't overdo—no, go give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I quickly corrected myself. This time, our Fusaichi Pandora won't lose. Not a chance...!
